 *But the right moment was broken when another creature came out from behind a bush and frightened the deer.  Miguel came out of his hiding place angrily, after all his meal and everyone who was there had just fled.*

 "Get the deer, now!"  *Miguel ordered the members of the pack to run after the prey, while Miguel went to take satisfaction with the current stranger.*
